name: Fourth Generation Information Systems Limited
about: Fourth Generation Information Systems Limited provides hardware and software product development, consulting, technology, and outsourcing services in India. The company offers various application services, including building new applications; maintaining and enhancing enterprise critical applications; increasing performance of legacy applications; web enabling for visibility and usability; creating streamlined and end-to-end virtual business processes; developing customized applications; integrating re-engineered and reconfigured legacy systems; and redeploying functioning of enterprise applications. It also provides hardware/software support and supply; scoping, consulting, implementation, customize, and training; integration across various technologies, such as CRM, ERP, and web services; and manpower consulting services. Fourth Generation Information Systems Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
